description: Data the stubbed main process (tests/smoke/stub-main.cjs) serves over IPC, in the DTO shapes the real handlers return (src/shared/types.ts). `wlanGroups` is the group list of an Omada 6.3 controller (`controllerVersion`) as OmadaController.getWlanGroups() returns it after joining setting/wlans with setting/ssids, so it includes AP groups without Wi-Fi networks (zNinguna, Exterior), and its Default group carries the default flag (`isDefault`, from setting/wlans `primary`); the legacy list carries none (the setting/ssids fallback has no such flag). `legacyWlanGroups` is the list of a pre-6.3 controller (`legacyControllerVersion`). The stub sorts by name like OmadaController does and derives the group model from the version with the real rule. One AP and one group carry malformed ids on purpose: the renderer must drop them (src/renderer/connection.ts loadData()). `clientNum` is optional (absent = unknown); the negative one must be dropped at the renderer boundary. Every id, MAC and name is made up.
